title: Rosalind and the Visitor
author: Beatrix Eastwick
blurb: Beatrix Winterbourne, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
